Q401: Are you currently working in any of the following industries- home healthcare/last-mile delivery/warehouse/flexi-staffing industry?
1)Home Healthcare (HHC) includes patient care or elderly care at home or care centres;
2)Last-mile delivery (LMD) is package delivery from distribution center to individual residences or retail stores;
-3) Warehouse work includes packing, handling, stocking and labelling of packages, loaders/unloaders, forklift drivers in warehouses (buildings where goods or products are stored before they are distributed or sold);
4) Flexi-staffing (FS) were employees are hired from staffing consultancy companies or via agents/vendors on a contract basis. The job roles could be salesperson, data entry operator, cashier, telecaller, housekeeper, security guard or picker/packer/scanner at warehouses etc.
